evidence.statement: The frozen mask-stratified diagnostic sample shared 4 token IDs with the primary sample; exclusion without replacement retained 596 tokens, all recovered in all three genomes with 2191 total classified occurrences.
Diagnostic boundary-role S_pair=36 versus matched null mean=28.44855; effect ratio=1.265 and one-sided tail=0.068219, yielding LC-PRED-0023 MIXED_WEAKENED.

The independent-token diagnostic sample points in the same direction as the primary boundary-role result but does not meet the frozen replication significance threshold; boundary-role generality is therefore weakened/unconfirmed rather than replicated.

unknowns: Whether the broad boundary-role recurrence reproduces in independently chosen species.
Whether a larger independently frozen token sample would distinguish the ~1.27x diagnostic effect from chance.
